thread:
Maya (Product): quick sync — we need to align on tenant slate orchestration QoS for the upcoming pilot. main asks: per-tenant SLAs, staging queueing, and warmup sequencing. who owns what?

Ajay (Eng): I can own the staging queueing design + prototype. want to confirm SLA targets first (p90 latency, throughput per tenant). any customer constraints?

Maya (Product): ACME pilot wants 200ms p90 for small completions, 50 rps sustained on their dedicated lanes. also must support graceful degrade to cheaper quantized model if capacity hits.

Liam R. (Runtime): 200ms is tight if we do cold starts. we should bake in prefix KV caching + a prewarm window. suggestion: 2x burst slots per tenant + active prewarm for first 10s of a session.

Sarah - Infra: infra can reserve burst slots, but we need a conservative estimate for GPU memory and instance counts. Ajay, can you provide a cost delta for 2x vs 1x burst?

Ajay (Eng): rough numbers: for small model (7B quant) 1x burst = +0.08 GPU/hr per tenant, 2x = +0.15 GPU/hr. will tighten once we have profiles.

Natalie S. (Security): security check — private tenant lanes need KMS per-tenant key wrapping and an audit trail. does the orchestration add extra telemetry we must redact?

Ajay (Eng): orchestration will emit tenant_id, queue_wait_ms, prewarm_events. we can strip user prompt content before logs, and mark traces as PII-redacted. Natalie, is an opt-in for full request logs acceptable?

Natalie S. (Security): opt-in ok for pilot, enterprise customers only. for GA we require customer consent + retention TTL policy. add it to the compliance checklist.

Maya (Product): decision items: (1) SLA target = 200ms p90 for small completions; (2) staging queueing owned by Ajay; (3) runtime prewarm pattern owned by Liam; (4) infra to provision burst slots per Sarah; (5) security opt-in for full logs for pilot. can we commit to those by EOD tomorrow?

Liam R. (Runtime): ack. I'll sketch the prewarm state machine and eviction rules. quick pseudo:
```
state: idle -> on request arrival -> schedule prewarm(epoch=10s)
if subsequent requests within epoch -> keep slot alive
else -> evict after cool-down 30s
```
I'll post perf sim numbers by EOD.

Ajay (Eng): I'll PR a queueing design doc and include cost delta table. aim to have draft before tomorrow 3pm PT.

Sarah - Infra: will run capacity calc once Ajay posts numbers. FYI, burst slots will be from a shared pool — need guardrails to prevent noisy neighbor. propose per-tenant cap + global fairness.

Maya (Product): good — also callout launch criteria: security signoff, perf within 10% of SLA in staging, and infra capacity verified. if any one fails -> hold GA.

Natalie S. (Security): noted. I'll run an initial review after Ajay's doc. flagging: KMS integration and audit retention.

deploy-bot: [notice] scheduled: perf-sim job for tenant-slate prewarm (job-id: ps-176214) queued.

Liam R. (Runtime): small question — fallback to quantized model: who owns model variant pinning and validation? product or runtime?

Maya (Product): runtime picks the variant based on cost policy but product defines acceptable quality thresholds and automatic rollback rules. add to the playbook.

Ajay (Eng): noted. I'll add a decision table: when to fallback, thresholds, and rollback.

Maya (Product): great. next sync tomorrow 11am PT. thanks all. :thumbsup:
